products.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint — Network Telemetry Visibility in Web Proxy / SWG Architectures (iboss, Zscaler, Loopback) — Commercial
products.short_description: Diagnose and remediate lost Defender for Endpoint network telemetry behind a loopback/forward web proxy — restore visibility for SmartScreen, Network Protection, Threat Intelligence, and Advanced Hunting.
products.description:
Diagnose and remediate lost Defender for Endpoint network telemetry behind a loopback/forward web proxy — restore visibility for SmartScreen, Network Protection, Threat Intelligence, and Advanced Hunting.

When a secure web gateway (iboss, Zscaler, or a local loopback/PAC agent) redirects endpoint traffic through a local listener before egress, MDE's endpoint sensor can record the proxy/loopback as the destination instead of the true remote — degrading network-dependent signals and leaving gaps in DeviceNetworkEvents. This solution measures exactly which telemetry is affected in your tenant, documents the feature impact, clarifies X-Forwarded-For applicability, and delivers a supported-topology remediation plus a Microsoft advisory support-ticket template to get authoritative answers.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Telemetry-impact assessment — read-only DeviceNetworkEvents completeness & destination-obfuscation checks (KQL) across a device sample
  • Feature-impact matrix — SmartScreen, Network Protection, Threat Intelligence, and DeviceNetworkEvents-dependent detections mapped to the proxy behavior
  • X-Forwarded-For (XFF) clarification — why XFF is server-side and what it does/doesn't restore for endpoint telemetry (confirm-with-Microsoft framing)
  • Supported-topology remediation — proxy mode, exclusions, connector/deployment guidance for a supported MDE + SWG coexistence
  • Microsoft advisory support-ticket template (Severity C) with the exact validate/document/architecture/schema asks

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Clear evidence of what network telemetry the proxy is costing you, a supported-topology fix, and the Microsoft advisory case to confirm it — visibility restored for your network-dependent Defender signals.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 4 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • MDEPROXY-Discovery.ps1 — read-only readiness for the Defender for Endpoint network-telemetry
    • MDEPROXY-FeatureImpact.ps1 — read-only enumeration of the network-dependent Defender surface
    • MDEPROXY-Report.ps1 — compiles the read-only telemetry-impact assessment report from the saved
    • MDEPROXY-Validate.ps1 — read-only measurement of DeviceNetworkEvents destination obfuscation and

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
